WITH eligible_high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.name,
    s.ncessch,
    s.low_grade_served,
    s.high_grade_served,
    s.low_grade_enrolled,
    s.high_grade_enrolled
  FROM schools s
  WHERE
    s.ncesdist = '0613360'
    AND s.status = 'Open'
    AND (
      -- Must actually enroll students through grade 12
      s.high_grade_enrolled = 12
      OR s.high_grade_served = 12 AND s.high_grade_enrolled = 12
    )
),
sat_participation AS (
  SELECT
    sat.ncessch,
    SUM(sat.num_test_takers) AS test_takers
  FROM satscores sat
  GROUP BY sat.ncessch
),
no_sat_schools AS (
  SELECT
    hs.name,
    hs.low_grade_served,
    hs.high_grade_served,
    hs.low_grade_enrolled,
    hs.high_grade_enrolled
  FROM eligible_high_schools hs
  LEFT JOIN sat_participation sp ON hs.ncessch = sp.ncessch
  WHERE
    sp.test_takers IS NULL OR sp.test_takers = 0
),

-- In the US, grade order: 'PK' (preschool), 'KG' (kindergarten), '01',..., '12'
-- We'll use an ordering key for the lowest actually enrolled grade to compare
grade_order AS (
  SELECT
    name,
    low_grade_served,
    high_grade_served,
    low_grade_enrolled,
    high_grade_enrolled,
    CASE
      WHEN low_grade_enrolled = 'PK' THEN 0
      WHEN low_grade_enrolled = 'KG' THEN 1
      WHEN length(low_grade_enrolled) = 2 AND substr(low_grade_enrolled, 1, 1) = '0' THEN CAST(substr(low_grade_enrolled, 2, 1) AS INTEGER) + 1
      WHEN length(low_grade_enrolled) = 2 THEN CAST(low_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER) + 1
      WHEN length(low_grade_enrolled) = 1 THEN CAST(low_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER) + 1
      ELSE 99 -- if somehow a higher or unknown code
    END AS min_grade_order
  FROM no_sat_schools
),
min_grade AS (
  SELECT MIN(min_grade_order) AS earliest_grade
  FROM grade_order
)
SELECT
  g.name,
  g.low_grade_served,
  g.high_grade_served
FROM grade_order g
JOIN min_grade m ON g.min_grade_order = m.earliest_grade
ORDER BY g.name;

WITH district_high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.GSserved,
    s.GSoffered,
    s.NCESDist
  FROM schools s
  WHERE
    s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND (
      -- Must actually enroll students in grade 12
      s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
    )
),
sat_counts AS (
  SELECT cds AS CDSCode, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS sat_takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
hs_with_sat AS (
  SELECT
    d.CDSCode,
    d.school_name,
    d.GSserved,
    d.GSoffered,
    COALESCE(s.sat_takers, 0) AS sat_takers
  FROM district_high_schools d
  LEFT JOIN sat_counts s ON d.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
),
eligible_schools AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    school_name,
    GSserved,
    GSoffered
  FROM hs_with_sat
  WHERE sat_takers = 0
),
split_grades AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    school_name,
    GSserved,
    GSoffered,
    CASE 
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'PK%' THEN 0
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'TK%' THEN 0.5
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'KG%' THEN 1
      WHEN GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(substr(GSserved,1,2) AS INTEGER)+1
      ELSE 99
    END AS low_grade
  FROM eligible_schools
)
, min_grade as (
  SELECT MIN(low_grade) as earliest_grade FROM split_grades
)
SELECT school_name, GSserved AS grade_span_served
FROM split_grades, min_grade
WHERE split_grades.low_grade = min_grade.earliest_grade
ORDER BY school_name ASC
LIMIT 100

    AND f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] < 700

),

  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(free_meal_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct
  FROM filtered_schools
),
charter_breakdown AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_schools,

),

    AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL

  FROM sat_scores_per_school
)

        s.GSserved,
        fr.FreeMealCountK12,
        fr.EnrollmentK12
    FROM schools s
    LEFT JOIN frpm fr ON s.SchoolID = fr.SchoolID
    WHERE instr(s.GSserved, '12') > 0 -- serves up through 12th grade
),
school_rates AS (
    SELECT
        es.SchoolID,
        es.SchoolName,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(es.Charter) = 'yes' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN LOWER(es.Charter) = 'no' THEN 'No'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS CharterSchool,
        es.GSserved,
        CASE
            WHEN es.EnrollmentK12 > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * es.FreeMealCountK12 / es.EnrollmentK12, 4)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS FreeMealRate
    FROM eligible_schools es
    WHERE es.EnrollmentK12 IS NOT NULL AND es.FreeMealCountK12 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT
        sr.*,
        MAX(sr.FreeMealRate) OVER () AS MaxRate
    FROM school_rates sr
    WHERE sr.FreeMealRate IS NOT NULL
),
sat_data AS (
    SELECT
        s.SchoolID,
        sat.TotalReadingMathWriting,
        CASE
            WHEN sat.TotalReadingMathWriting IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
            WHEN sat.TotalReadingMathWriting < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
            WHEN sat.TotalReadingMathWriting <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
            WHEN sat.TotalReadingMathWriting > 1500 THEN 'Above Average'
        END AS SATPerformanceLevel
    FROM schools s
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.SchoolID = sat.SchoolID
)
SELECT
    rs.SchoolName,
    printf('%.4f', rs.FreeMealRate) AS FreeMealRate,
    rs.CharterSchool,
    rs.GSserved AS GradesServed,
    COALESCE(sd.SATPerformanceLevel, 'No SAT Data') AS SATPerformanceLevel
FROM ranked_schools rs
LEFT JOIN sat_data sd ON rs.SchoolID = sd.SchoolID
WHERE rs.FreeMealRate = rs.MaxRate
ORDER BY rs.SchoolName;

  SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes', CDSCode FROM benchmark

stat_per_set AS (
    SELECT
        set_name,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mana_cost IS NOT NULL AND mana_cost <> '') AS total_with_mana_cost,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mana_cost IS NOT NULL AND mana_cost <> '' AND mana_value <= 3) AS num_mana_cheaper
    FROM set_cards
    GROUP BY set_name
)

    set_name,
    CASE
        WHEN total_with_mana_cost = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * num_mana_cheaper / total_with_mana_cost, 2)
    END AS percent_mana_cost_3_or_less

WITH
-- 1. Find Abyssal Horror's card id(s)
abyssal_horror_ids AS (
  SELECT id FROM cards WHERE lower(name) = 'abyssal horror'
),
-- 2. Find all sets where Abyssal Horror appears with release details
abyssal_horror_sets AS (
  SELECT c.setCode AS set_code, s.releaseDate
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE c.id IN (SELECT id FROM abyssal_horror_ids)
),
-- 3. The first-printed set for Abyssal Horror
first_abyssal_horror_set AS (
  SELECT set_code, releaseDate
  FROM abyssal_horror_sets
  WHERE (releaseDate, set_code) = (
    SELECT MIN(releaseDate), MIN(set_code)
    FROM abyssal_horror_sets
    WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MIN(releaseDate) FROM abyssal_horror_sets)
  )
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 4. The most recently released set in the database
most_recent_set AS (
  SELECT code AS set_code, releaseDate
  FROM sets
  WHERE (releaseDate, code) = (
    SELECT MAX(releaseDate), MIN(code)
    FROM sets
    WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM sets)
  )
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 5. Gather both needed sets
selected_sets AS (
  SELECT set_code, releaseDate FROM first_abyssal_horror_set
  UNION ALL
  SELECT set_code, releaseDate FROM most_recent_set
),
-- 6. For each set, count cards with a mana cost, and those with convertedManaCost <= 3
cards_with_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ss.set_code,
    s.name AS set_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> '' THEN 1 END) AS cards_with_mana_cost,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> '' AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 END) AS cards_mana_3_or_less
  FROM selected_sets ss
  JOIN sets s ON s.code = ss.set_code
  JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = ss.set_code
  GROUP BY ss.set_code, s.name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN cards_with_mana_cost > 0
         THEN (cards_mana_3_or_less * 100.0) / cards_with_mana_cost
         ELSE NULL END
    , 2
  ) AS pct_mana_3_or_less
FROM cards_with_counts
ORDER BY set_name;

-- 4. Last transaction per account dated on or before 1996-12-31
last_tx_max_date AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           MAX(t.date) AS last_date
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_1996)
      AND t.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
last_tx_max_id AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.trans_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    INNER JOIN last_tx_max_date lt
        ON t.account_id = lt.account_id AND t.date = lt.last_date
),
last_transaction AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           MAX(trans_id) AS last_trans_id
    FROM last_tx_max_id
    GROUP BY account_id
),
eoy_balances AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance

    INNER JOIN last_transaction ltp
        ON t.account_id = ltp.account_id AND t.trans_id = ltp.last_trans_id
),

WITH

  SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.district_name, d.region, d.A2 AS population
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
-- 2. Withdrawal transactions (type = 'VYDAJ')
withdrawals AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS withdrawal_count
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
   WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
   GROUP BY a.district_id
),
-- 3. Standing-order debits by account
so_debits AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, SUM(o.amount) AS standing_order_total
    FROM "order" o
    JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
   WHERE o.type = 'SIPO'
   GROUP BY a.account_id
),
-- 4. Accounts + standing order debits (0 if none)
acct_so_debits AS (
  SELECT
    awd.district_id,
    awd.account_id,
    COALESCE(sod.standing_order_total, 0) AS standing_order_total
  FROM acct_with_district awd
  LEFT JOIN so_debits sod ON awd.account_id = sod.account_id
),
-- 5. District-level aggregates: accounts, population, total SO debits
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    awd.district_id,
    awd.district_name,
    awd.region,
    awd.population,
    COUNT(awd.account_id) AS num_accounts,
    SUM(asd.standing_order_total) AS total_so_debits
  FROM acct_with_district awd
  LEFT JOIN acct_so_debits asd ON awd.account_id = asd.account_id
  GROUP BY awd.district_id, awd.district_name, awd.region, awd.population
),
-- 6. Combine district info with withdrawal and SO aggregates
district_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ds.district_name,
    ds.region,
    ds.population,
    w.total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(CAST(w.total_withdrawn AS REAL)/ds.population, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    ds.num_accounts,
    ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(ds.total_so_debits,0) AS REAL)/ds.num_accounts, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
  FROM district_stats ds
  JOIN withdrawals w ON ds.district_id = w.district_id
  WHERE ds.population >= 100000
),
-- 7. Rank districts by withdrawals per inhabitant (competition ranking)
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank
  FROM district_metrics
)
SELECT
  district_name,
  region,
  population,
  total_withdrawn,
  withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
  withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank,
  avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM ranked
ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank, district_name;

    t.type,
    t.amount,
    t.bank,
    t.account,

  FROM trans t
),
agg_trans AS (
  SELECT
    g.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.ext_counterparty IS NOT NULL THEN t.ext_counterparty END) AS num_external_counterparties

  LEFT JOIN trans_external t ON g.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY g.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_loans
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    g.account_id,
    d.district_name,
    d.region,
    COALESCE(a.total_amount_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
    COALESCE(a.total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(l.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
    COALESCE(a.num_external_counterparties, 0) AS num_external_counterparties
  FROM gold_credit_accounts g
  LEFT JOIN district_info d ON g.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN agg_trans a ON g.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_counts l ON g.account_id = l.account_id
),
with_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY num_external_counterparties DESC) AS ext_network_rank
  FROM final

  district_name,
  region,
  total_amount_received,
  total_amount_withdrawn,
  num_loans,

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Female', 6.5
),

    p.PatientID,
    p.Sex

  WHERE l.TestName = 'uric-acid'
    AND l.ResultValue > s.upper_limit
)

  SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /

  (
    -- Case 1: result is a pure number (e.g., '100')

    OR
    -- Case 3: result includes value in parentheses after dipstick grade (e.g., '+2(100)')
    (
      l_p.Result LIKE '%(%'
      AND
      CAST(
        SUBSTR(
          l_p.Result, 
          INSTR(l_p.Result, '(') + 1,
          INSTR(l_p.Result, ')') - INSTR(l_p.Result, '(') - 1

    m.carcinogenicity,

    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_count
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.id = a.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.id
),
molecule_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    COUNT(b.id) AS bond_count,
    -- Carbon-touching bonds: a bond where atom1 or atom2 is carbon within the molecule
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
    -- Multiple bonds: bond_type 'double' or 'triple'
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.id = b.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom a1 ON b.atom1_id = a1.id
  LEFT JOIN atom a2 ON b.atom2_id = a2.id
  GROUP BY m.id
),
carbonous_molecules AS (
  SELECT
    ma.*,
    COALESCE(mb.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count,
    COALESCE(mb.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
    COALESCE(mb.multiple_bond_count, 0) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM molecule_atoms ma
  LEFT JOIN molecule_bonds mb ON ma.molecule_id = mb.molecule_id
  WHERE ma.carbon_count >= 1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    carcinogenicity,
    atom_count,
    bond_count,
    carbon_count,
    chlorine_count,
    carbon_touching_bond_count,
    multiple_bond_count,
    -- Rank as specified: carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, atom_count DESC, molecule_id ASC
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, atom_count DESC, molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank
  FROM carbonous_molecules
)
SELECT
  rank,
  molecule_id,
  carcinogenicity,
  atom_count,
  bond_count,
  carbon_count,
  chlorine_count,
  carbon_touching_bond_count,
  multiple_bond_count
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank ASC;

  FROM molecule m

  LEFT JOIN chlorine_atoms cl ON m.molecule_id = cl.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom_counts ac ON m.molecule_id = ac.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON m.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_bonds ctb ON m.molecule_id = ctb.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN multiple_bonds mb ON m.molecule_id = mb.molecule_id
  WHERE COALESCE(ca.num_carbons, 0) >= 1
)

  ) AS rank,
